faq_a1.message: I-ApplyFlow iyisandiso se-Chrome esinamandla e-AI esizitholela futhi sigcwalise amafomu okufaka isicelo somsebenzi kuzo zonke izinkundla ezingu-15+ ezihlanganisa i-LinkedIn, i-Internshala, i-Unstop, i-Workday, i-Greenhouse, i-Lever, nokuningi. Ifunda iphrofayela yakho elondoloziwe futhi isebenzisa ukufanisa okuhlakaniphile ukuze igcwalise izinkambu zombhalo, okwehliswayo, izinkinobho zomsakazo, namabhokisi okuhlola — okuhlanganisa imibuzo ye-EEO/demographic.

faq_q2.message: Ingabe idatha yami yomuntu siqu iphephile nge-ApplyFlow?

faq_a2.message: Yebo. Idatha yakho igcinwa endaweni ku-chrome.storage.local yesiphequluli sakho ngokuzenzakalelayo. Ayikaze ithunyelwe kunoma iyiphi iseva yomuntu wesithathu ngaphandle kwesizindalwazi sakho se-Supabase ozikhethela sona (osilawulayo). I-ApplyFlow ayidayisi, yabelane, noma yenze imali ngolwazi lwakho lomuntu siqu.

faq_a3.message: I-ApplyFlow isekela amapulatifomu angu-15+ aphuma ebhokisini: I-LinkedIn Easy Apply, Internshala, Unstop, Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, iCIMS, SmartRecruiters, BambooHR, Jobvite, Taleo, Naukri, Ngempela, Wellfound/AngelList, kanye nanoma iyiphi enye isayithi ngokusebenzisa i-generic fallback matcher yethu ehlakaniphile.

faq_a4.message: I-Web Clipper iyinkinobho entantayo ethi "Londoloza Umsebenzi" (📌) evela ngokuzenzakalelayo lapho uvakashela noma yiliphi ikhasi lohlu lwemisebenzi. Ukuyichofoza kukhipha isihloko somsebenzi, inkampani, iholo, kanye nencazelo, bese kuyilondoloza kusilandeleli sakho se-ApplyFlow njengohlelo lokusebenza "Elulondoloziwe" — ukuze ukwazi ukulandelela imisebenzi ngaphambi kokufaka isicelo.

faq_a5.message: Vula i-popup ye-ApplyFlow, chofoza ithebhu ethi "Iphrofayela", bese ulayisha i-PDF yakho yokuqalisa kabusha. I-AI izogcwalisa ngokuzenzakalelayo zonke izinkambu zakho. Ungakwazi futhi ukuhlela mathupha noma iyiphi inkambu okuhlanganisa okuncamelayo kwe-EEO, ukugunyazwa komsebenzi, nezinhlamvu zekhava.

faq_q6.message: Yiziphi izinkambu ze-EEO futhi kungani ngizidinga?

faq_a6.message: Izinkambu ze-EEO (Equal Employment Opportunity) ziyimibuzo abaqashi abaningi base-US nabasemhlabeni jikelele abayibuzayo mayelana nobulili, isimo sokukhubazeka, isimo sokuba umakadebona, nokugunyazwa komsebenzi. I-ApplyFlow igcina izimpendulo ozincamelayo futhi igcwalisa ngokuzenzakalela la maqembu wezinkinobho zomsakazo ukuze ungawaphenduli mathupha njalo.

faq_q7.message: Ingabe i-ApplyFlow idinga okhiye be-API noma ukulungiswa?

faq_a7.message: Cha! I-ApplyFlow iphatha konke ukutholwa kwefomu, ukufaniswa okuhlakaniphile, ukukhiqizwa kwezinhlamvu zekhava, kanye namagoli okusebenzisana ngokuzenzakalelayo. Awudingi ukuthola noma ukulungisa noma yibaphi okhiye be-API.

faq_a8.message: Ukuvumelanisa kwe-Supabase kuyisici esingakhethwa sokulondoloza ifu. Uma ungena nge-Google futhi uyivula, iphrofayili yakho nesilandeleli sohlelo lokusebenza kuvumelaniswa kusizindalwazi samafu esiyimfihlo ukuze idatha yakho yenziwe isipele futhi ifinyeleleke kumadivayisi amaningi. Lokhu kungokuzithandela ngokuphelele - isandiso sisebenza ungaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi ngokugcwele.

faq_q9.message: Kungani i-ApplyFlow idinga ukufinyelela kuwo wonke amawebhusayithi?

faq_a9.message: I-ApplyFlow icela ukufinyelela kuwo wonke amawebhusayithi ukuze ikwazi ukufaka injini yokugcwalisa ngokuzenzakalela kunoma yiliphi ifomu lesicelo somsebenzi, futhi ibonise inkinobho yokunamathisela ethi "Londoloza Umsebenzi" kunoma yiluphi uhlu lwemisebenzi. Le mvume iyadingeka ukuze kusekelwe inkundla ebanzi. Sijova kuphela imibhalo emakhasini ahlobene ngokusobala nomsebenzi.

faq_a10.message: Ibhodi le-Kanban liwukubuka kokulandela umkhondo komsebenzi kuthebhu ye-Tracker. Ibonisa izinhlelo zakho zokusebenza ezihlelwe ngamakholomu: Kulondoloziwe → Kusetshenzisiwe → Ukuhlola → Ingxoxo → Okunikezwayo. Ungahudula bese uphonsa amakhadi phakathi kwamakholomu ukuze ubuyekeze isimo sanoma yiluphi uhlelo lokusebenza.

faq_a11.message: Uma unika amandla okuthi "Ngena kuphela ngemva kokuhambisa" kuzilungiselelo, i-ApplyFlow ibukela izinguquko zekhasi ezibonisa ukuthunyelwa ngempumelelo (njenge-URL equkethe "/impumelelo" noma umbhalo womzimba othi "Siyabonga ngokufaka isicelo"). Ifaka kuphela uhlelo lokusebenza ku-tracker yakho ngemuva kokuthola ukuthunyelwa kwangempela.

faq_a12.message: Yebo! Isikrini Sephrofayela sinesigaba esithi "I-Cover Letter Vault" lapho ungagcina khona izinhlamvu zekhava ezingenamkhawulo eziklanyelwe izindima noma izinkampani ezahlukene. Uma ugcwalisa ngokuzenzakalelayo, i-ApplyFlow izosebenzisa incwadi yakho yekhava yakamuva noma efaneleke kakhulu.

faq_q13.message: Ngiyithekelisa kanjani idatha yami yohlelo lokusebenza?

faq_a13.message: Iya kokuthi I-Akhawunti Nokuvumelanisa → skrola uye phansi → chofoza okuthi "Khipha Isipele (JSON)". Lokhu kulanda yonke iphrofayela yakho nedatha yohlelo lokusebenza njengefayela le-JSON ukuze ligcinwe.

faq_a14.message: Imodi yedemo bekuyisilungiselelo sefa esisetshenziselwa ukuhlola. Manje ikhutshaziwe ngokuzenzakalela. Zonke izici zibukhoma futhi ziyasebenza ngokhiye owakhelwe ngaphakathi we-Gemini API.

faq_q15.message: Ngisibika kanjani isiphazamisi noma ngicele isici?

faq_a15.message: Sicela uvule inkinga endaweni yethu yokugcina ye-GitHub (exhunywe esigabeni esithi Mayelana) noma usithumele i-imeyili kokuthi support@applyflow.in. Ngokuvamile siphendula phakathi namahora angu-48.

NL_14__Siqoqa kuphela ulwazi olunikeza ngokuzithandela ukuze unike amandla izici zesandiso:

NL_30__**3. Siyigcina Kanjani Idatha Yakho**
NL_32__**3.1 Isitoreji Sendawo (Okuzenzakalelayo)**
Yonke idatha igcinwa ngokuyinhloko ku-Chrome.storage.local API yesiphequluli sakho. Le datha ihlala kudivayisi yakho kuphela futhi ayilokothi idluliselwe kunoma iyiphi iseva ngaphandle kwesenzo sakho esisobala.

**3.2 Ukuvumelanisa Kwamafu (Ngokuzithandela)**
Uma ukhetha ukungena ngemvume nge-Google futhi unike amandla isici se-"Supabase Sync", iphrofayela yakho nedatha yohlelo lokusebenza izophinde ihambisane ne-Supabase. Ugcina ubunikazi obugcwele bale datha. Ungayisusa noma nini esigabeni se-Akhawunti Nokuvumelanisa.
NL_38__**3.3 Izicelo ze-Gemini AI**
Lapho kusetshenziswa izici ze-AI (isb., ukukhiqizwa kwe-eseyi, ukuhlaziya umsebenzi), izingxenye zephrofayela yakho (amakhono, iziqu, isifinyezo) kanye nombhalo wencazelo yomsebenzi i-Gemini ithunyelwa ku-Google API. Lokhu kucutshungulwa ngaphansi Kwemigomo Yesevisi ye-API ejwayelekile ye-Google kanye Nenqubomgomo Yobumfihlo. Sincoma ukuthi ungafaki izihlonzi zomuntu siqu ezibucayi kokuqukethwe kwakho okusizwa yi-AI.
